hero.title: For law firms and advisers who manage their clients’ companies
hero.description: Sttok brings together on one screen every company the firm manages, with what is pending in each one sorted by deadline. From there the firm keeps shareholder registers and minute books, calls meetings, issues certificates and legalises registers.

situations.title: Common situations in a law firm

rows.situation: Registers have to be legalised by April
rows.action: It shows each company's books, which are overdue, and records each legalisation.

rows.situation: The annual general meeting is due in many companies
rows.action: The work is launched across several companies at once and each one is tracked.

rows.situation: A client brings years of unrecorded deeds
rows.action: It reads the deeds with AI, chains the transactions and flags gaps in the history.

rows.situation: A client's bank asks for a certificate
rows.action: It is generated from the register with today's data, ready to sign.

rows.situation: A shareholder wants to sell and there is a pre-emption right
rows.action: It manages the notices and deadlines set in the articles and records the transfer.

rows.situation: Each lawyer handles their own clients
rows.action: Permissions are granted per company: each person at the firm sees only theirs.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions from law firms

items.q: Can I manage companies for different clients?
items.a: Yes. They all appear on one screen, with what is pending in each, and can be grouped into collections by client or by lawyer.

items.q: Can the client access their company?
items.a: Yes, with the role the firm gives them: administrator, director, shareholder or read-only.

items.q: Can I load a client's history from the deeds?
items.a: Yes. Sttok reads the deeds, proposes each transaction for review and flags gaps and errors in the history.

items.q: Can I prepare meetings for several companies at once?
items.a: Yes. Recurring work, such as the annual general meeting or preparing and filing accounts, is launched for several companies and tracked from the home screen.

items.q: Does it generate minutes and certificates?
items.a: Yes. The meeting minutes are drafted from attendance and results, and certificates are generated from the register with today's data.

items.q: Does it work for companies in Latin America?
items.a: The platform adapts to each country's terminology: shareholder ledger, general shareholders' meeting, board of directors. Compliance with each country's regulations is assessed case by case.
